description: Edit Brain knowledge the user asked to correct or change. Send only the fields to change (type, title, content, tags, platforms, importance, pinned, valid_until). Requires workspace settings permission. Saved workspace knowledge and agency entries (scope agency) are editable; agency entries need the agency owner or staff with Agency Brain permission, cannot be pinned, and return memory_id null (use entry.id). Entries synced from the brand profile, website, interviews, products or documents return 409 BRAIN_ENTRY_DERIVED, to be changed at their source. If queued is true, the edit is saved: do not repeat it. Reuse idempotency_key on retries.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

pinned.description: Pin or unpin the entry. pinned=true is not supported for agency entries (400 BRAIN_AGENCY_PIN_UNSUPPORTED); false unpins.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

valid_until.description: End of validity (ISO 8601 date-time). REST callers may send null to clear it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_brain_entry
title: Update Brain Entry
